objective.primary: maximize Delta(F)=min_v(U(exists v.F)-N^2) on states reachable at the frozen ordinary-elimination callsite

search_policy.reason: selector elimination creates a large exact reachable product state while the source remains compact
search_policy.juxtapose: evaluate multiple deterministic source clones across increasing leaf clause counts and independent seeds

exactness.U: raw unique state units before optional subsumption, matching eliminate_var_capped cap semantics
exactness.overflow_witness: for a pivot, exact streaming generation may stop immediately after raw units first exceed N^2; this proves final U>N^2
exactness.Delta_positive_gate: every live pivot must independently cross N^2
exactness.reachability_gate: final candidate must be replayed by unmodified PIRC_DECISION_CORE_V0_4 up to the exact ordinary-elimination callsite and match the candidate fingerprint

falsification_logic.L1A_refuted_if: reachable AND all pivots overflow AND max_pair_frequency < s-2N+11
falsification_logic.L1B_refuted_if: reachable AND all pivots overflow AND P < 2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11)
falsification_logic.L1_requires_additional_gate: after a reachable all-pivot-overflow state is found, frozen exhaustive v2 must also return no rescue; L1 is not refuted by L1A/L1B failure alone
